checked.label: heating return temperature
checked.needed_for: sets district water flow = Q / (cp * (100 - T_return)) and the HEX/heat-pump lift

checked.label: cooling return temperature
checked.needed_for: sets the chilled-water temperature glide (20 C OFFICIAL supply) and so the chiller duty

checked.label: brine specific heat
checked.needed_for: enters every heat balance (HEX, absorption drive, heat pump source, boiler, CHP)

checked.label: absorption chiller COP (thermal)
checked.needed_for: sets the brine drive heat per MW of cooling at the hot end

checked.label: absorption chiller minimum drive inlet temperature
checked.needed_for: decides on which days the brine is hot enough to drive the absorption chiller

checked.label: absorption chiller minimum drive outlet temperature
checked.needed_for: limits how much drive heat the brine can give the chiller (drive-water glide)

checked.label: electric chiller COP
checked.needed_for: sets the electricity (and emissions) of the cooling the absorption chiller does not cover

checked.label: heat pump Lorenz efficiency
checked.needed_for: sets the heat pump COP for the lift to 100 C, and so its electricity

checked.label: heat pump COP cap
checked.needed_for: caps the heat pump COP at small lifts, where the Lorenz COP is unrealistically high

checked.label: produced gas emission factor
checked.needed_for: sets the CO2 of the produced gas burned in CHP/boiler or flared (combustion + CO2 pass-through)

checked.label: external (pipeline) gas emission factor
checked.needed_for: sets the CO2 of the boiler top-up gas (external gas)

checked.label: grid electricity emission factor
checked.needed_for: sets the CO2 of the ESP, heat pump and chiller electricity

title: Source temperature vs 100 C supply
rationale: Reservoir at 2500 m is 87.0 C, 13.0 K below the fixed 100 C supply before any losses, so a HEX alone cannot supply 100 C. Options: (a) deeper well - T_res = 100 C needs 2933 m, and direct HEX supply (T_res >= 107.4 C incl. 5 K approach, 0.4 K surface drops, ~2 K wellbore loss) needs ~3180 m; (b) surface upgrade - heat pump on the brine leaving the HEX plus CHP on the produced gas. Decision: start with (b) at the official 2500 m (no extrapolated reservoir data, least drilling), then climb a 250 m depth ladder (max 4000 m) and keep each step only if emissions fall >= 5%; the ranking decides with numbers.

title: Proposal n1_q650_s1.8_ua1000_z2500
rationale: Start with the fewest doublets (1): the ranking prefers fewer doublets, so the smallest plant that passes the hard constraints is the target. Flow sizing heuristic: peak 30.0 MW / 1 doublet(s) at the 40 K brine cap -> 639.4 m3/h per doublet, rounded up to 650 m3/h. Largest ESP (s = 1.8), HEX 1000 kW/K, official 2500 m reservoir.
